semantics: Summary is display-only; it never settles cooldown, protection, access or usage statistics.
Panel authentication 401 is distinct from Google upstream_status 401.
Local missing credential is HTTP404 reason credential_not_found; unknown route is not the same.
403 is a permission error, not permanent unsupported capability.
Only explicit window metadata identifies 5h or weekly; never infer from resetTime or rolling168h.
Missing window or fraction is not zero and not full. Never duplicate one ratio into two windows.
Old quota/test/verify-project APIs remain independent. Do not call them automatically as fallback.

frontend_author: Official Antigravity CLI only, through the existing shared hook.py dispatcher
sensitive_views: Explicit confirmation every time; fetch legacy panel endpoint only after confirmation; clear on close/channel change/logout; no persistent cache.
phases: P1 quota visual sample and customer confirmation

safe_config.safe_false: config excludes api_password,panel_password,password; top-level secret_fields={key:{configured:bool}}; no-store
safe_config.reveal_true: legacy unchanged; request only after per-open confirmation
